commonCharacterPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE production game animation spritesheet, precisely 4 columns x 4 rows, exactly 16 full-body poses of the SAME character. Image 1 is the character identity: preserve its face, outfit, props, scruffy wobbly black outlines and flat muted colours. Image 2 is ONLY an animation-layout reference: replace the rogue in EVERY cell with the character from image 1, no rogue features or outfit retained. All 16 poses must face RIGHT, matching the direction of the layout reference. Identical scale and baseline in all cells, generous transparent gutters, no cropped parts. Row 1: idle eyes open; idle eyes closed blinking; travel pose A; travel pose B. Row 2: travel pose C; travel pose D; take out a parchment letter; extend the letter. Row 3: finish tossing letter right; startled recoil; hunched dejected pose holding a refused letter; annoyed stomp. Row 4: crouch to jump; celebratory hop; triumphant smile with arms or signature prop raised; return to idle. Travel A/B/C/D must have visibly DIFFERENT leg and arm positions for a real loop, including passing legs and alternate stride. Preserve fully opaque character interiors and GENUINE TRANSPARENT RGBA background. No checkerboard, coloured backdrop, ground, shadows, labels, grid lines or text. Sharp game art, clear silhouettes.

variants.chest: Use case: stylized-concept, production game chest animation. Use the referenced chest's exact identity: scuffed warm oak planks, dark teal metal straps with brass rivets, black irregular hand-inked outlines, tiny golden keyhole. Create ONE HORIZONTAL SPRITE STRIP with EXACTLY FIVE evenly spaced poses, left to right. 1: fully closed chest. 2: lid ajar 25 degrees, a very small warm light inside. 3: fully open lid, short golden rays rising from the interior. 4: fully open lid, 3 tiny reward sparkles rising just above it. 5: fully open EMPTY chest with a dark wooden interior, no light, no rays, no sparkles, the calm permanent looted state. SAME front three-quarter viewpoint, identical perspective, base size, rigid box shape, metal bands, scale, bottom baseline and position inside each cell in all five poses. Only lid and light change. No huge stars or explosive rays. Real transparent RGBA background, no ground or shadow, no checkerboard, no text, no cell borders, wide generous transparent gutters. Crisp flat muted colours and opaque wood and metal, matching the reference exactly.
